volumio_info.changelog: 3.4.5 Exclusive Soloist vs stock Spotify Connect metering (DSD pcm.spotify + setPeppyMetering), genuine persist on volatile Soloist pause, turntable persist countdown, ignore stale seek re-broadcasts, negative meter sensitivity (−12..+12 dB), theme gallery portrait/layout and preview-refresh fixes, hold meter FIFOs so peppyalsa can open before the screensaver, Soloist DSD meter named from install marker not STARTED; 3.4.4 Solid anti-aliased progress/volume arcs (PIL 4x LANCZOS), Volumio-parity infinity as optional 4th repeat state (legacy shuffle-slot documented), transparent icon clear fixes (repeat single ghost), procedural bar fill.radius, format type display mode/align/clip, optional unlimited fanart images, uninstall removes leftover /home/volumio/peppy_screensaver git clone; 3.4.3 Remote reload config-version fix (VU-meter save, gallery theme apply), fanart cache and interval fixes, non-Latin artist name support, slideshow continuity across skin changes, memory-bounded folder/fanart decode; 3.4.2 Themes & Artwork section (theme gallery preview + remove controls), artist fanart slideshow (personal art / local fanart / fanart.tv / Volumio cascade, per-track and timed cadence, fade/merge transitions, personal/project fanart.tv key mode), separate samplerate colour, progress markers up to 10, multiple folder image layers (e.g. back cover + band logo from the track folder, separate positions), italic font style (with its own font.size.italic), and an optional fill/tail behind the image volume slider knob; settings reorganised into task-based sections (Audio Source, Display & Activation, Themes & Artwork, Meter, Performance & Rendering, Rotation & Reels, Text Scrolling, Animation, Template File Sharing); rotation speed multipliers (vinyl/spool) are now Custom-quality only; fixed fractional settings (e.g. animation fade duration) being truncated to integers; 3.4.1 Meter sensitivity (dB) control with engine gain path and upgrade-safe refresh; 3.4.0 Continuity Engine - backup and restore plugin settings across reinstalls; 3.3.2 - Multi-client remote (unicast discovery/level/spectrum); theme-follow reload fix; 3.3.1 peppy_fonts defaults and config toggle.
